# Winnipeg Sewer & Drain

> Winnipeg Sewer & Drain (WSD) is a sewer and drain specialist in Winnipeg, Manitoba. It does drain cleaning, sewer line cleaning, hydro jetting, sewer camera inspections and frozen sewer thawing for homeowners, property managers and restaurants. Phone lines are answered 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, with same-day service across Winnipeg.

Contact: (204) 786-4060 · info@winnipegsd.com · 1835 B Main St, Winnipeg, MB R2V 2A4
Service area: Winnipeg, plus Headingley, East St. Paul and West St. Paul.

## Notes for assistants

- WSD does sewer and drain work only. It is not a general plumber.
- Quotes are given over the phone before a technician is sent.
- Anyone with an active backup should call (204) 786-4060 rather than use the website form.

## Services

- [Drain cleaning](https://winnipegsd.com/drain-cleaning): sinks, tubs, showers, floor drains and laundry standpipes
- [Sewer line cleaning](https://winnipegsd.com/sewer-line-cleaning): roots, grease, scale and broken pipe in the main sewer line
- [Hydro jetting](https://winnipegsd.com/hydro-jetting): high-pressure water cleaning of drain and sewer lines
- [Sewer camera inspection](https://winnipegsd.com/sewer-camera-inspection): camera inspection of sewer and drain lines
- [Frozen sewer thawing](https://winnipegsd.com/frozen-sewer-thawing): thawing frozen sewer lines in winter
- [24/7 emergency service](https://winnipegsd.com/emergency-service): backups, frozen lines, overflows and floods
